observations: All three photos show the same black keyboard lying on an artificial grass background, photographed from different angles.
Photo 0 shows the left edge of the key-bed with the word "YAMAHA" printed vertically, followed by smaller text that looks like "Portatone" or similar, partly obscured by a watermark.
Photo 2 shows the same left-corner branding more clearly: "YAMAHA" is legible, with a sub-model name that is too small/blurred to read fully.
The control panel has sliders, buttons labeled ORCHESTRA, AUTO BASS CHORD, DIGITAL, MULTI MENU, TEMPO, etc. - consistent with a late-1980s/1990s home keyboard.
No power adapter, box, stand, or accessories are visible in any photo.
No photo shows the keyboard powered on, no screen lit, no indication of sound output.
Watermarks ('POSTED ON JI... MARY OLUGBAMI') overlay the images but do not obscure the brand text.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: No photo shows the unit powered on or demonstrates sound/key function; 'quality and good' cannot be judged from stills.
Photo 0 and photo 2 both show 'YAMAHA' printed on the keyboard body; no Casio markings appear anywhere.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have faulty keys/sliders
risks.proof: A video clip of the keyboard being switched on, keys pressed, and sound playing
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: Missing power adapter or battery compartment corrosion
risks.proof: Photo of the power input port and any included adapter, plus a photo of the open battery compartment
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, assume adapter not included

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in these angles (cracked keys, broken sliders, missing buttons)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each key row and the full control panel in good light

risks.risk: Mismatched brand claim in listing text raises doubt about overall listing accuracy
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit photo of the full brand/model nameplate and serial number
risks.if_unproven: treat identity as Yamaha (per photos) but flag listing reliability as low

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on with sound and key response
Clear close-up of the brand/model plate (left edge near the keys)
Photo of the power port / included adapter and battery compartment
Full panel photo in good lighting without watermark obstruction
response.reason: The item is visually identifiable as a Yamaha-branded electronic keyboard despite the seller's contradictory 'Casio' claim; with no proof of power-on function or completeness, it must be priced at worst-case (untested/incomplete) condition.
